page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What it is
steps.why: Parturition is simply the medical name for birth, so the definition should be one plain line.
common_mistakes: Confusing parturition with gestation. Gestation is the pregnancy; parturition is the birth.
lines: Parturition is the process of delivery of

steps.label: The hormone
steps.why: Oxytocin makes the smooth muscle of the uterus contract, and those contractions push the baby out.
common_mistakes: Naming progesterone. That maintains the pregnancy rather than ending it.
steps.memory_tip: Oxytocin from the posterior pituitary contracts the uterus.
steps.margin_note: Name it and say what it does.

lines.text: Oxytocin induces parturition by uterine contractions

insider_note: Oxytocin is the single marked name. Add that it contracts the uterine muscle, which is why it works.
